name: Kell Retreat
description: Six timber buildings, a well, and a founder who has genuinely not decided yet what any of it is for. The stone the chapel will stand on for three hundred years is still in the ground behind the well. Meridian has offered an endowment, and what happens to that offer decides who gets to stand here later.

variants.description: Six timber buildings, and surveyor's stakes for six more. Meridian's money has arrived and the wall it buys is already drawn on the plan — a good wall, well made, and a wall is a thing that decides who is inside it.
Six timber buildings and a well, and a charter nailed to the doorpost saying this place belongs to whoever is standing in it. No endowment, no wall, and no plan for the winter that is coming.
